versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Fermentation & Food Preservation" skill.
- Covers fundamental preservation methods: fermentation, pickling, canning, drying, and smoking.
- Includes beginner-friendly, step-by-step instructions for lacto-fermentation (sauerkraut), fermented pickles, and kimchi.
- Provides safety rules (with focus on botulism prevention), equipment basics, and universal salt ratios.
- Localization guidance covers canning standards by region, altitude adjustments, temperature/measurement units, and typical jar types.
- References trusted sources, including USDA, NCHFP, and "The Art of Fermentation".
